summary: Body of a 29-year-old solo climber found at the base of a cliff at Officers Gulch (Officers Wall) after an overnight search; SCRG set up a technical rigging system to recover the body from the boulder field to the parking lot.
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Summit County Sheriff
notes: Last contact ~5 p.m. Sept 2; reported missing when he did not return; body found 7:50 a.m. Sept 3; name not released.
